scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @metricas-dspd/contratos -w @metricas-dspd/metricas -w @metricas-dspd/mock -w @metricas-dspd/web -w @metricas-dspd/server && npm exec -w e2e -- tsc --noEmit
scripts.format: prettier --write web packages eslint.config.js tsconfig.base.json package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check web packages eslint.config.js tsconfig.base.json package.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run format:check
scripts.pronto: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run pronto --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up
